## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the new behavior (bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] `task test`, `task lint`, and `task lint-web` pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (README, `docs/`)
- [ ] No plaintext, keys, passphrases, or tokens are logged, stored, or sent to the server
- [ ] Commits are signed and follow Conventional Commits

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/haukened/gone/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
